knownLimitations: Importer remaps some fields and adds defaults; canonical graph retains original fields.
CSV quoted-field parser/exporter and preservation of node metrics/edge IDs have been implemented with regression tests; successful CI and full browser validation remain unconfirmed.

Importer supports only a narrow regex-parsed Cypher subset; complex expressions, escaped string values, and arbitrary properties are not fully supported. Basic relationship endpoint alias resolution and numeric weight preservation are implemented, but full-fidelity round trips are not yet guaranteed.

svg.note: Export-only in the current application UI; not an import fixture.
